outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic icon plus micrograph images illustrating cropping/rotation/resizing; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic cell outlines and micrograph images illustrating image spacing, not a data plot.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrograph images illustrating insets/magnification, not a data plot.
Panel d shows grayscale micrograph images at different brightness/contrast settings, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color swatches and micrograph images with channel annotations, not a data plot.
Panel f shows a schematic and grayscale micrograph images illustrating channel separation, not a data plot.
Panel g shows micrograph images with calibration/intensity scale legends, which are illustrative color scales rather than plots of averaged data.
